mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_watch_technical_session (symbol, market, stock_name, period_type, session_key, bridge_target_id, conversation_url, status, generation, context_chars, context_limit_chars, last_run_at, last_run_status, last_error) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{market}, #{stockName}, #{periodType}, #{sessionKey}, #{bridgeTargetId}, #{conversationUrl}, #{status}, #{generation}, #{contextChars}, #{contextLimitChars}, #{lastRunAt}, #{lastRunStatus}, #{lastError})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stock_watch_technical_session WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND market = #{market} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(period_type, 'DAY') = #{periodType} ORDER BY generation DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_watch_technical_session SET status = #{status}, last_error = #{lastError}, gmt_modify = NOW() WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND market = #{market} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(period_type, 'DAY') = #{periodType}

UPDATE stock_watch_technical_session SET bridge_target_id = #{bridgeTargetId}, conversation_url = #{conversationUrl}, context_chars = #{contextChars}, last_run_at = #{lastRunAt}, last_run_status = #{lastRunStatus}, last_error = #{lastError}, gmt_modify = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
